{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：葬書一卷，舊本題晉郭璞撰。璞有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"爾雅註，已著録。葬地之説，莫知其所自來。周","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"官冡人、墓大夫之職，稱皆以族葬，是三代以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"上葬不擇地之明證。漢書藝文志形法家以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"宮宅地形與相人、相物之書並列，則其數自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7637341161178284086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"漢始明，然尚未專言葬法也。後漢書袁安傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"載安父沒，訪求葬地，道逢三書生，指一處，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"世為上公。安從之，故累世貴盛。是其術盛傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"於東漢以後。其特以是擅名者，則璞為最著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"考璞本傳載璞從河東郭公受青囊中書九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"卷，遂洞天文、五行、卜筮之術。璞門人趙載嘗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"竊青囊書，為火所焚，不言其嘗著葬書。唐末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"有葬書地脈經一卷、葬書五隂一卷，又不言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7637341161178300470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"為璞所作。惟宋志載有璞葬書一卷，是其書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"自宋始出。其後方技之家競相粉飾，遂有二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"十篇之多。蔡元定病其蕪雜，為删去十二篇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"存其八篇。吳澄又病蔡氏未盡藴奥，擇至純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"者為內篇，精麤純駁相半者為外篇，麤駁當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"去而姑存者為雜篇。新喻劉則章親受之呉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"氏，為之註釋。今此本所分內篇、外篇、雜篇，盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"猶呉氏之舊本。至注之出於劉氏與否，則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7637341161178316854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"可考矣。宋志本名葬書，後來術家尊其説者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"改名葬經。毛晉汲古閣刻本，亦承其譌，殊為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"失考。今仍題舊名，以從其朔焉。乾隆四十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"年十月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣即一元運行之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169539123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"在天則周流六虚，在地則發","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169555507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169555507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"天無此則氣無以資，地無此則形無以載。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169571891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169588275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"磅礴乎大化，貫通乎品彚，無處無之，而無時不運也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169588275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618851849182249003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"陶侃曰：先天地而長存，後天地而固有。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169604659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋亦指此云","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169621043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169621043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"且夫生氣藏于地中，人不可見，惟循地之理以求","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169637427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"之，然後能知其所在。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169637427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"葬者能知其所在，使枯骨得以","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169653811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"乗之，則地理之能事畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169653811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"土圭所以辨方正位，其制見于周禮。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742820954139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"玉尺所以度量","logicSentenceId":"7666016742820970523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"逺邇，其數生于黄鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742820970523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"今臺司度日影以定候，多用此","logicSentenceId":"7666016742820986907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1649,"lineType":1,"content":"制也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742820986907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"夫葬乾者，勢欲起伏而長，形欲濶厚而方。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821003291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"葬坤者，勢欲","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821019675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"連辰而不傾，形欲廣厚而長平。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821019675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"葬艮者，勢欲委蛇而順，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821036059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265533993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"形欲高峙而峻。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821036059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"葬巽者，勢欲峻而秀，形欲銳而雄。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821052443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"葬震","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821068827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"者，勢欲緩而起，形欲聳而峩。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821068827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"葬離者，勢欲馳而窮，形欲","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821085211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"起而崇。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821085211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"葬兌者，勢欲天來而坡垂，形欲方廣而平夷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821101595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"葬","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821117979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"坎者，勢欲曲折而長，形欲秀直而昻。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821117979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"此言八卦之山，必欲合如是之形勢，然後為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821134363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821150747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"下山川行度，千變萬化，豈有一定之理哉？","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821150747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"何者不欲","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821167131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"起伏而長，濶厚而方，寧獨乾之一山如是哉？","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821167131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"此只言","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821183515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"其大槩耳，是以形勢為上，而方位次之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821183515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"必欲如此，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821199899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"神吉神，鬼凶煞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821314587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"朔謂歲月日時，言藏神合乎吉朔也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821330971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"神迎鬼避得吉年月也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821347355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"憑福恃勢，為四凶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821511195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265583145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"憑見在之福，恃當今之勢，富貴之家，自謂常如今日，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821527579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"而不深慮。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821527579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"有父母之喪者，不思盡力以求宜隱之地，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821543963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"但茍焉窀變而已。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821543963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"正程子之所謂唯欲掩其目之不","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821560347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"見，反以隂陽之理為無足","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821576731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1717,"lineType":2,"content":"缺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"可勝道哉！","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821576731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"魏","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"志：管輅遇征東將軍母丘儉之墓，嘆曰：松栢雖茂，無","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"形可文。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"碑諡雖美，無後可守。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821609499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武垂頭，青龍無足，白","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821625883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"虎銜屍，朱雀悲泣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821625883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"四危已備，去當滅族。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821642267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"後果如其言。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821658651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"又左氏春秋傳㑹文公十三年，邾文公卜遷于繹，史","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821675035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265599529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：利于民，不利于君。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821675035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：茍利于民，孤之利也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821691419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"左右","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821707803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：命可長也，君何弗為？","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821707803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：命在養民，民茍利矣，遷","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821724187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"也，吉莫如之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821724187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"遂遷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821740571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"五月，公果卒。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821756955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"然固有數焉，而隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821773339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"之理，亦有所定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821773339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
